operator_rule.scope: offensive candidate selection and future offensive scoring
operator_rule.primary: weapon damage; for melee, weapon damage and attack speed evaluated together
operator_rule.secondary: relevant troop skill or attribute points, considered only after the weapon comparison

supersedes.reason: The recommendation led with TwoHanded, Throwing, Athletics and Riding without first establishing the weapon damage and melee speed. A crafted weapon template or a high skill value is not the missing weapon output.

candidate.reentry_condition: Verify the carried weapon and its damage/speed for the relevant usage against version-compatible direct values or a validated reconstruction, compare alternatives weapon-first, then consider relevant skills last.

evidence.limitation: This audit supplies the item identity/template, not a verified damage/speed pair. No exhaustive claim is made that no other repository artifact could supply it.

unchanged: empirical battle records and completed-test results
